reply.text:
I hear the fear in that, and it's worth taking seriously. Eating carbs is not something you have to avoid to train, and cutting them out does not make a workout work better. For the eating side, the Nutrition tab can show you what you've logged and what your targets are, and a dietitian is the right person if the fear around food is getting in the way of your training or your life.

On the training side, you can keep lifting and running in a way that doesn't depend on any one food. If you tell me what you're aiming for, strength, size, or just feeling steady week to week, I can talk through how I'd approach it. I can also pull up your recent sessions to show you what you've been doing and how you've been fueling the work. Which would help more?
